lucide Car/Wifi/Route/Zap -> SemanticIcon color note: the web title icon is `Car className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-cyan-400"` (L74), the per-stat icons are `Car`/`Wifi`/`Route`/`Zap className="h-3.5 w-3.5"` (L47/53/60/66), and the empty-state icon is `Car className="h-5 w-5"` (L87). lucide has no native renderer; SemanticIcon tone is fixed per name (vehicle->accent 'EV', wifi->success 'WF', navigation->accent 'NV', bolt->warning 'ZP'), so the text-cyan-400 title tint collapses to the icon's intrinsic tone — the same color-tint -> semantic-icon collapse precedent set by DashboardStats (text-indigo-400->layoutDashboard) and MonthlyMileage (neon-cyan->analytics). Car->vehicle, Wifi->wifi, Route->navigation (lucide Route is a route/navigation glyph), Zap->bolt. Title + per-stat icons -> size='sm' (web h-3.5≈sm); empty icon -> size='md' (web h-5 w-5≈md). The fleet-stats-bar semantic intent is preserved.

The web help/widgetId/dashboardId/actions/noPadding/query WidgetShell props are not passed by this widget, so the inlined shell omits them (structurally identical output).

Inlined native WidgetStatGrid reproduces the web ./shared contract: empty stats -> EmptyState 'No stats available' (web L45); else resolvedCols = compact ? 1 : cols ?? autoCols(stats.length) (autoCols verbatim: %3->3, %4->4, else 2) mapped to a fixed RN column grid via width styles (cellC1=100%/cellC2=50%/cellC3=33.33%/cellC4=25%) inside a wrapping row with -6/-6/-12 gutter margins + 6/12 cell padding — the web @container grid-cols table (grid-cols-2 baseline, @xs/@sm collapses) has no RN equivalent so it collapses to the resolved fixed count (this widget passes cols={4}, so standard size -> 4 cols, compact size.rows<2 -> 1 col); each cell renders the ported native StatCard with label/value/unit/icon/trend mapped 1:1. The web stat.valueColor -> StatCard className has no native StatCard equivalent and is unused by this widget (no statItem sets it), so it is intentionally dropped (kept in the StatGridItem type for contract parity).

Inlined native WidgetShell reproduces the web shell subset this widget exercises (loading -> Skeleton placeholder View accessibilityRole progressbar; error -> ported QueryError in a centred padded View; titled header icon+uppercase 11px muted title+DataFreshness; web WidgetShell L59-80 pulse-on-change effect ported verbatim with a green glow shadow). This widget always passes a title so the title-less overlay-freshness branch is structurally present but unused, retained for parity with the DashboardStats/MonthlyMileage inlined shell.

State/prop names (size, vehicles, vehiclesLoading, analytics, analyticsLoading, error, analyticsFetching, analyticsStale, analyticsIsError, analyticsUpdatedAt, refetchAnalytics, unitPrefs, toDistanceDisplay, distanceUnit, isLoading, stats, vehicleCount, onlineCount, totalDistance, totalEnergy, isCompact, hasData, items, onlinePct), API paths ('/vehicles', '/analytics/fleet?days=30'), snake_case query param (days) and snake_case response fields (total_distance_km, total_energy_kwh, state), all i18n keys (widget.fleetStatsBar.title/vehicles/online/onlineNow/distance30d/energy30d/noData), the size.rows<2 compact breakpoint, the cols={4} grid, and the convertDistanceFromSI unit handling are all preserved. Unit handling: SI stays on the wire; distance is converted only at the render boundary via convertDistanceFromSI(value, unitPrefs.distance) with unitPrefs.distance ('km'|'mi') from the ported useFormatPrefs — NO new Mi/Min/Mph/Kwh-suffixed field, JSON key, or DB column is introduced (Phase-48 SI-canonical compliant). No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or web @/ UI imports remain — only react, react-native primitives (StyleSheet/View), the shared native SemanticIcon/AppText + theme tokens, and the ported parity StatCard/DataFreshness/QueryError/useVehicles/useFleetAnalytics/useFormatPrefs/convertDistanceFromSI.
